name: Baran Kebap Haus
kurzbeschreibung:
**Baran Kebap Haus in Ramsau im Zillertal**

Welcome to **Baran Kebap Haus**, your authentic taste of Turkish cuisine right in the heart of **Ramsau im Zillertal**. Whether you're craving a juicy **Döner Kebap**, a flavorful **Lamb Kebap**, or a hearty **Adana Kebap**, our freshly prepared dishes will satisfy your hunger. Don’t miss our delicious **Lahmacun** or a warm bowl of **Cacık**—perfect for sharing with friends or enjoying on your own.

After a day of exploring the stunning **Zillertal** or skiing on the slopes of **Ahornbahn** and **Hochzillertal**, treat yourself to a meal that brings a taste of the Mediterranean to the Alps. Our cozy atmosphere and friendly service make **Baran Kebap Haus** the ideal spot for a quick bite or a relaxed dinner.

Come by and experience the best of Turkish flavors in the beautiful setting of **Tirol**!
